variables.name: Mac / Computer Name
variables.input:
timeseries avg(macos.cpu.usage), by: {host.name}
| fields host.name
| dedup host.name
| sort host.name asc

0.content:
# 🍎 Mac Health Dashboard
Real-time macOS system health monitoring — CPU, Memory, Swap & Disk at a glance.

2.title: CPU Usage %
2.query:
timeseries cpu = avg(macos.cpu.usage), by: {host.name}
| filter in(host.name, array($MacHostName))

3.title: CPU Breakdown — User vs System vs Idle

4.title: Current CPU Usage (Single Value)
4.query:
timeseries cpu = avg(macos.cpu.usage), by: {host.name}
| filter in(host.name, array($MacHostName))
| fieldsAdd current_cpu = arrayLast(cpu)
| fields host.name, current_cpu

6.title: Memory Usage %
6.query:
timeseries mem = avg(macos.memory.usage), by: {host.name}
| filter in(host.name, array($MacHostName))

7.title: Memory Breakdown — App / Wired / Compressed (GB)
7.query:
timeseries {
  app        = avg(macos.memory.app),
  wired      = avg(macos.memory.wired),
  compressed = avg(macos.memory.compressed)
}, by: {host.name}
| filter in(host.name, array($MacHostName))
| fieldsAdd
    app_gb        = app[]        / 1073741824,
    wired_gb      = wired[]      / 1073741824,
    compressed_gb = compressed[] / 1073741824
| fields timeframe, interval, host.name, app_gb, wired_gb, compressed_gb

8.title: Memory Used vs Total (GB)

9.title: Current Memory Usage (Single Value)
9.query:
timeseries mem = avg(macos.memory.usage), by: {host.name}
| filter in(host.name, array($MacHostName))
| fieldsAdd current_mem = arrayLast(mem)
| fields host.name, current_mem

11.title: Swap Used vs Total (GB)

12.title: Swap Usage % (Calculated)

14.title: Disk Usage %
14.query:
timeseries disk = avg(macos.disk.usage), by: {host.name}
| filter in(host.name, array($MacHostName))

15.title: Disk Free vs Total (GB)

16.title: Current Disk Usage (Single Value)
16.query:
timeseries disk = avg(macos.disk.usage), by: {host.name}
| filter in(host.name, array($MacHostName))
| fieldsAdd current_disk = arrayLast(disk)
| fields host.name, current_disk

18.title: Mac Health Summary — Latest Values
18.query:
timeseries {
  cpu        = avg(macos.cpu.usage),
  memory     = avg(macos.memory.usage),
  disk       = avg(macos.disk.usage),
  swap_used  = avg(macos.memory.swap.used),
  swap_total = avg(macos.memory.swap.total)
}, by: {host.name}
| filter in(host.name, array($MacHostName))
| fieldsAdd
    cpu_pct    = round(arrayLast(cpu), decimals: 1),
    memory_pct = round(arrayLast(memory), decimals: 1),
    disk_pct   = round(arrayLast(disk), decimals: 1),
    swap_pct   = round((arrayLast(swap_used) / arrayLast(swap_total)) * 100, decimals: 1)
| fields host.name, cpu_pct, memory_pct, disk_pct, swap_pct
| sort host.name asc
